text:
emily: heads-up — new support ticket: quickstart curl example in README broke a customer's automation on Windows.
marc: which quickstart? can you paste the snippet?
emily: the README shows this (copied from docs):
```
curl -X POST \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY " \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  --retry 5
```
emily: notice the trailing space after $REDWOOD_KEY and the `--retry` on a POST. on Windows users often paste the exact string including the trailing space into $env:REDWOOD_KEY and it becomes part of the header value.
rachel: yeah that's the two-pronged bug: trailing-space token -> 401 -> client retries; retrying a non-idempotent POST can cause duplicate requests. automation scripts are the real victim here.
marc: docs-bot flagged this pattern before. i'll do a small patch: (1) remove trailing space, (2) add a recommended idempotency example for POSTs, (3) add a Powershell variant and a short callout "avoid --retry with POST unless you include an Idempotency-Key".
emily: also add a line that quickstarts are safer to demonstrate with GET for the minimal flow. many customers literally copy the curl into healthchecks.
rachel: SDK parity note: our language quickstarts are inconsistent about retry semantics. Ruby shows auto-retry, Go shows manual retry wrapper, Node recommends `retry: true` and Python shows a RetryConfig class. that's confusing for new integrators. we should file an SDK parity issue.
docs-bot: created docs issue #4722: "quickstart curl idempotency + SDK retry parity". recommended PR template drafted.
infra-bot: server note: we treat header token exactly as-is; trimming would be forgiving but could hide real misconfigurations. flagged PS to eng-runtime for visibility.
marc: opening small PR to fix content, will include these concrete snippets:
--- curl POST with idempotency (unix):
```
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"input":"sample"}'
```
--- powershell version (windows):
```
$env:REDWOOD_KEY = "REPLACE_WITH_KEY"
$guid = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_KEY"; 'Idempotency-Key' = $guid } -Body '{"input":"sample"}' -ContentType 'application/json'
```
marc: i'll also add a short callout under the quickstart: "Use GET for copy/paste introduction or include Idempotency-Key when showing POST + --retry."
emily: please also update the Node/Python snippets to match wording about retries (small callout in each language block).
docs-bot: added checklist item: update language quickstarts for retry parity (link: issue #4722).
marc: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2401 — fixes curl formatting, adds PS example, and adds retry/idempotency callout.
infra-bot: pinged eng-runtime on PR for awareness about token trimming discussion.
support: confirmed with the customer — after updating the quickstart curl to remove trailing space or use the idempotency example their automation stopped failing. closing the ticket.
deploy-bot: docs PR #2401 merged to main and published to docs.redwood.ai (live). :shipit:
emily: thanks team — small README typos cause real automation outages. closing this thread.
